name: Morse.cdet
hypotheses: ii² = −I and ii M = M ii (M complex-linear for the complex structure ii) — Milnor's setting; orthogonality of ii is not needed
difference: Junk values only: outside ii² = −I, ii M = M ii the blind value is 0 while the project's polynomial det(M_ℂ P₊ + P₋) is whatever it is (ii = 0, M = 1 gives 1). Conventions agree: in both, √−1 acts as +ii.
why: Proved agree_of: ψ(v, w) = P₊v + w is a ℂ-linear isomorphism (ℝ^ι, ii) × ker P₊ ≃ ℂ^ι (since P₊ ii = √−1 P₊) conjugating M_ℂP₊ + P₋ to M × id, so det(M_ℂP₊ + P₋) = det_ℂ(M) by LinearMap.det_conj and det_prodMap. This confirms the project's P₊ = (1 − √−1 ii)/2 sign convention; differ shows the junk difference.
